title: Implementation Engineer
text:
At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

What Expel can do for you:

Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.

Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.

Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.

Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.

Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.

Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

What you can do for Expel:

Own the customer onboarding journey. Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.

Bring customers live with confidence. Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.

Help customers get the most out of Expel. Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.

Keep implementations moving. Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.

Get ahead of potential issues. Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.

Make customer transitions seamless. Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.

Help us continuously improve. Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.

Support the broader team. Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

What You Should Bring With You

2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.

Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.

Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.

A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.

Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.

title: AI Builder
text:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Technical Requirements, must-have:

1. Python in production

Idiomatic Python — packages and modules, type hints, exception handling, dependency and virtual-environment management. You can read an unfamiliar codebase and change it safely.

2. Django

Models, migrations, querysets, the admin, middleware, settings across environments. You understand the ORM well enough to know when it will generate a bad query.

Serializers, viewsets, permissions, authentication, pagination, versioned endpoints, and a clean OpenAPI/Swagger contract.

Schema design, migrations, indexing, reading query plans, transaction behaviour, and writing non-trivial SQL by hand. You can tell whether a query will hold up under load.

Experience with an asynchronous task or message queue — Celery with Redis or RabbitMQ, RQ,  or equivalent. Queues and workers, scheduling, retries with backoff and failure handling, and debugging a job that silently never ran. You know why a task must be safe to execute twice.

Working knowledge as a broker/result backend and cache: keys and expiry, data structures, connection and memory behaviour, and what happens when it fills up or restarts.

7. pandas or polars

Loading and transforming tabular data from CSV, Excel, JSON and Parquet. Comfortable with joins, reshaping, dtypes, null handling, and tracing a bad value from source file to database record.

8. Google Cloud Platform (or an equivalent cloud platform like Azure, AWS)

Cloud Run or equivalent compute, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, and enough IAM literacy to not over-grant. You can deploy, read the logs, and find out why a job failed.

Design, execute, and automate comprehensive test cases and test scenarios to validate our automotive platforms using various test methodologies to identify and track actionable defects and track them to closure.
 Participate in deep-dive reviews of product requirements and technical designs, providing critical feedback to ensure features are built for testability and security from day one.
Partner closely with project management, hardware teams, and software developers to provide rigorous technical analysis of bugs and publish data-driven statistical reports for global team members.
Architect and maintain a distributed test automation framework capable of managing high-concurrency workloads across an extensive automation farm of hundreds of concurrent systems.
Develop sophisticated test libraries and  automation solutions to accelerate development cycles and expand automated test coverage for reliable and 100% 
 Drive the full automation lifecycle, from analyzing log failures and logging defects to leading bug-scrub cycles that ensure high-quality product releases.

What we need to see:
2+ years  proven experience in an automation engineering or software development role.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics & Electrical Engineering.
Solid foundation in QNX or Linux-based operating systems, including a detailed understanding of system concepts and boot sequences.
 Professional experience in System SW validation, including Bootloaders, BSP, ARM Trusted Firmware, Trusted OS (TOS), and Secure Boot protocols.
Strong Python or C++ skills with a focus on writing clean, maintainable, and testable code from a systems-level perspective.
Deep familiarity with AI-native development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or LLM APIs to optimize engineering velocity.
A clear understanding of LLM failure modes—including hallucination and context degradation—and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI-generated outputs.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
 Consistent track record of identifying vulnerabilities in low-level firmware or secure-boot implementations.
 Practical history of deploying prompt engineering or LLM-based agents within a production-grade CI/CD pipeline.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. Basic understanding of material properties and hardware and electrical component design.
Good written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or other Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
